first_copy_status: Interrupted task-owned rsync to remove per-file fsync bottleneck; resumed retained files; final filesystem flush after verification.
verification: Exact inventory and SHA-256 source/copy comparison; source size/mtime inventory unchanged during copy and verification.
limitations: Same-machine separate-filesystem copy; not an offsite backup. Symlinks, if any, preserve links without following their targets.
elapsed_seconds_scope: Final verification attempt only; excludes the two copy attempts.

physical_storage.evidence: Host mapper resolution and /sys/class/block/dm-{3,5}/slaves show distinct physical disks.
